name: expense-tracker-backend
description: Backend API for Expense Tracker Application

scripts.kill-port: node -e "const { exec } = require('child_process'); const port = process.argv[2] || '5000'; const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const cmd = isWin ? `powershell -Command \"Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort ${port} | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force }\"` : `lsof -ti:${port} | xargs kill -9`; exec(cmd, (err) => { if (err) console.log('No process found on port', port); else console.log('Process on port', port, 'terminated'); });"
